selectedRuns.sql: SELECT * FROM observation_runs ORDER BY block, position

attempts.sql: SELECT * FROM observation_attempts ORDER BY block, position, attempt

deviations.sql: SELECT * FROM experiment_deviations ORDER BY recorded_at, id

query.sql: SELECT u.id, u.session_id, u.turn_index, u.agent_id, u.parent_tool_call_id, u.model, u.input_tokens, u.output_tokens, u.cache_read_tokens, u.cache_write_tokens, u.reasoning_tokens, u.total_nano_aiu, u.request_multiplier, u.duration_ms, u.time_to_first_token_ms, u.inter_token_latency_ms, u.initiator, u.api_endpoint, u.reasoning_effort, u.finish_reason, u.content_filter_triggered, u.created_at, s.cwd FROM assistant_usage_events u JOIN sessions s ON s.id = u.session_id WHERE substr(u.created_at, 1, 10) >= '2026-07-28' AND (s.cwd LIKE 'X:\code\copilot-worktrees\P01\%' OR s.cwd LIKE 'X:\code\copilot-worktrees\P02\%' OR s.cwd LIKE 'X:\code\copilot-worktrees\P03\%' OR s.cwd LIKE 'X:\code\copilot-worktrees\P04\%' OR s.cwd LIKE 'X:\code\copilot-worktrees\P05\%' OR s.cwd LIKE 'X:\code\copilot-worktrees\P06\%' OR s.cwd LIKE 'X:\code\copilot-worktrees\P07\%' OR s.cwd LIKE 'X:\code\copilot-worktrees\P08\%' OR s.cwd LIKE 'X:\code\copilot-worktrees\P09\%' OR s.cwd LIKE 'X:\code\copilot-worktrees\P10\%') ORDER BY u.session_id, u.id LIMIT 10000

SELECT f.session_id, f.file_path, f.tool_name, f.turn_index, f.first_seen_at, s.cwd FROM session_files f JOIN sessions s ON s.id = f.session_id WHERE substr(f.first_seen_at, 1, 10) >= '2026-07-28' AND (s.cwd LIKE 'X:\code\copilot-worktrees\P01\%' OR s.cwd LIKE 'X:\code\copilot-worktrees\P02\%' OR s.cwd LIKE 'X:\code\copilot-worktrees\P03\%' OR s.cwd LIKE 'X:\code\copilot-worktrees\P04\%' OR s.cwd LIKE 'X:\code\copilot-worktrees\P05\%' OR s.cwd LIKE 'X:\code\copilot-worktrees\P06\%' OR s.cwd LIKE 'X:\code\copilot-worktrees\P07\%' OR s.cwd LIKE 'X:\code\copilot-worktrees\P08\%' OR s.cwd LIKE 'X:\code\copilot-worktrees\P09\%' OR s.cwd LIKE 'X:\code\copilot-worktrees\P10\%') ORDER BY f.session_id, f.turn_index, f.file_path LIMIT 10000
